title: Speak Readings - schedule required
body:
Hi, 
Would be nice to have schedule (time of day, days of week) for Speak Readings. It is very useful, but not allowed at school.

comments.body: Have you ever heard of Tasker? XDrip+ has great Tasker integration and it would take you about 5 minutes to make profiles controlling speech any time of the day automatically.

Yes, i know about task scheduling apps. But why to use 3 party app if it can be done on xDrip itself?
In my case i use smartwatch battery of which is holding max 10 hours, and installing extra apps will reduce that even more.

@Exeter  Tasker is installed on your phone, not your watch. It has no effect on your watch battery.

@jamorham has provided Tasker compatability to take care of minor scheduling issues with things like spoken readings. Also, the watch has nothing to do with spoken readings.

@doc77 You are not understanding. I use Finow Q1 Pro, which is full Android smartwatch, it does not require phone to operate, it is with SIM card (2G, 3G, 4G), Wifi. My child is NOT carrying another phone with this.
So everything is done on this watch only.
@exceter What is the status now?  Is this capability still missing?
He can just enable it when he arrives home from school, and he can disable it when he leaves home on his way to school, right?
